description:
A lender's loans on GONDI one by one, found by address, GONDI
username or ENS name; pass the name or address the user gives as
`wallet`, no need to resolve it first. Per loan: the NFT, the
borrower, what the wallet lent and the loan's whole principal in its
currency and in USD, APR gross and net of the protocol fee, start and
expiry, days left, interest earned and still due, and for an open or
defaulted loan the collection's floor and top collection bid today
with the loan's principal over the floor, to judge its risk. Answers
"what loans do I have out?", "which come due soonest?", "which are
underwater?" (loan_to_floor_percent above 100) and, with status
CLOSED, "how did my past loans end?". `summary` counts and totals every
matching position, not only the rows returned: per status, overdue,
and principal, interest and profit per currency. For per-currency
returns over all time, call get_lender_returns. To list more loans
call again with offset=next_offset; never send the user to the site
for the loans a page left out. Send the user to a loan's gondi_url,
its NFT's page on GONDI, to claim or follow it.

offset.description: Skip this many positions: pass the previous answer's next_offset for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

status.description: OPEN: the running loans, due soonest first. DEFAULTED: the ones past due unpaid, whose NFT the lender can claim or that are at auction. CLOSED: the finished ones, repaid, refinanced or renegotiated away, claimed or auctioned, ended latest first.
status.title: Status

wallet.description: The lender: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

name: list_lender_loans

LenderLoan.description:
One row per position: a loan the wallet lent into, or its tranche of
one. Kept to what a lender's questions read, since a wallet can hold
hundreds and every byte of a row is paid once per position. The NFT is
named by its collection slug and token id, which `get_nft_market` answers
the contract address for.

days_left.description: Until ends_at for an OPEN position, 0 once it passed, when the lender can claim the NFT unless the borrower repays first; null for any other status.
days_left.title: Days Left

ends_at.description: The loan's expiry, or, for a REFINANCED or RENEGOTIATED position, when it was repaid.
ends_at.title: Ends At

floor_price.description: The collection's floor today; null when nothing is listed, and for a closed position.

interest_earned.description: Interest earned so far, net of the protocol fee.

interest_left.description: For an OPEN position, the interest still due by expiry, net of the protocol fee; null for any other status.

loan_principal.description: The loan's whole principal, every lender's together; the principal the collateral backs.

loan_to_floor_percent.description: loan_principal over floor_price, in USD when their currencies differ: above 100 the floor no longer covers the loan. Null without both.
loan_to_floor_percent.title: Loan To Floor Percent

net_apr_percent.description: apr_percent net of the protocol fee: what the lender earns.
net_apr_percent.title: Net Apr Percent

net_profit.description: For a closed position, what it made or lost net of fees: interest and fees on a repayment, and the collateral's worth against the principal on a claim or an auction; null while it is open or defaulted.

principal.description: What this wallet lent into the loan.

status.description: OPEN: lent and running. DEFAULTED: past due unpaid, the NFT the lender's to claim. SENT_TO_AUCTION: past due and being auctioned. REPAID: the borrower paid it back. FORECLOSED: the lender claimed the NFT. AUCTIONED and AUCTIONED_WITH_BUYOUT: the NFT was sold at auction, or bought out by a lender, and the proceeds paid out. REFINANCED: another lender's better terms repaid this lender's principal and interest. RENEGOTIATED: the borrower moved the loan to new terms, which repaid this lender.
status.title: Status

top_collection_bid.description: The highest open bid on the whole collection today, which a claimed NFT could be sold into; null when there is none, and for a closed position.

LenderLoan.title: LenderLoan

LenderLoansSummary.description: Totals over every scanned position, not only the `loans` returned.

interest_earned.description: Interest earned so far, net of the protocol fee, one per currency.
interest_earned.title: Interest Earned

interest_left.description: Interest the OPEN positions are still due by expiry, net of the protocol fee, one per currency.
interest_left.title: Interest Left

loan_count.description: The positions summarized: matching_loan_count, or the 300 first in the list's order when the wallet has more.
loan_count.title: Loan Count

net_profit.description: What the closed positions made or lost net of fees, one per currency.
net_profit.title: Net Profit

overdue_loan_count.description: OPEN positions past their expiry, whose NFT the lender can claim unless the borrower repays first.
overdue_loan_count.title: Overdue Loan Count

principal.description: What the wallet lent into them, one per currency.
principal.title: Principal

status_counts.description: The positions per status: how the closed ones ended.
status_counts.title: Status Counts

LenderLoansSummary.title: LenderLoansSummary

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

gondi_url.description: The wallet's profile on its Lent tab, which lists them.
gondi_url.title: Gondi Url

matching_loan_count.description: Every position of the wallet in the requested status: the exact total, even when `loans` holds only the first `limit` of them.
matching_loan_count.title: Matching Loan Count

next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page of positions; null on the last page, or past the first 300.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

wallet_address.description: The lender the positions belong to.
wallet_address.title: Wallet Address

wallet_name.description: The name the address was resolved from; null when the call passed an address.
wallet_name.title: Wallet Name

title: Lender loans
